sources.title: Steerable Cultural Preference Optimization of Reward Models
sources.snippet: A new training algorithm called Steerable Cultural Preference Optimization (SCPO) aims to make large language models more responsive to diverse cultural subcommunities, according to research published on arXiv [1]. The method separately evaluates community preferences to reduce bias while improving minority-group model performance [1].

sources.title: Multi-Cultural Preference Optimization of Reward Models
sources.snippet: It is essential for large language model (LLM) technology to serve many different cultural sub-communities in a manner that is acceptable to each community. However, research on LLM alignment has so far predominantly focused on predicting a unified response preference of annotators from certain regions. This paper aims to advance the development of alignment models with a more global outlook ...

sources.title: Steerable Cultural Preference Optimization of Reward Models
sources.snippet: Quick Answer The paper introduces a novel reward model training algorithm, SCPO, which enhances large language models' alignment with diverse cultural preferences, achieving up to 7-point performance improvements on minority models across two datasets, while being 280% more data-efficient than traditional fine-tuning methods.
